proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X n m σ2 ε hn hε hL hI hm hv
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hv1 : ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / n) P = σ2 / n := by
    have e : (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)) = fun ω => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω := by
      funext ω; ring
    have hsum : ProbabilityTheory.variance (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i) P = n * σ2 := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum (fun i _ => hL i) (fun i _ j _ hij => hI i j hij)]
      simp [hv]
    have e2 : (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i := by
      funext ω; simp [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [e, ProbabilityTheory.variance_const_mul, e2, hsum]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨hv1, ?_⟩
  have e2 : (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)) = fun ω => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i) ω * (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    funext ω; simp [Finset.sum_apply, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hLS : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ)) 2 P := by
    rw [e2]
    exact (MeasureTheory.memLp_finsetSum' (Finset.range n) (fun i _ => hL i)).mul_const _
  have hmean : ∫ ω, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / (n : ℝ) ∂P = m := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_div, MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hL i).integrable one_le_two)]
    simp [hm]
    field_simp
  have hC := ProbabilityTheory.meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq hLS hε
  rw [hmean, hv1] at hC
  have hnn : 0 ≤ σ2 / n / ε ^ 2 := by
    have : 0 ≤ σ2 / n := by rw [← hv1]; exact ProbabilityTheory.variance_nonneg _ _
    positivity
  have := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hC
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hnn] at this
  refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (m σ2 ε : ℝ), 0 < n → 0 < ε → (∀ i, MeasureTheory.MemLp (X i) 2 P) → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (X i) (X j) P) → (∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂P = m) → (∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.variance (X i) P = σ2) → ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / n) P = σ2 / n ∧ P.real {ω | ε ≤ |(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / n - m|} ≤ σ2 / (n * ε ^ 2)
